name: SILK
oneLiner: SILK is Shade Protocol's basket-pegged stable on Secret Network, tracking a GDP-weighted currency basket and overcollateralized through ShadeLend CDP vaults.
collateral: Crypto assets via ShadeLend overcollateralized vaults (ATOM, SCRT, stablecoins like USDC, SHD governance token) plus stablecoin redemption pools; targets 100-150% system-wide collateralization ratio
pegMechanism: NAV tracks a governance-set basket of global currencies and commodities (currently USD ~33.5%, EUR ~22.9%, Gold ~18.7%, JPY ~11.1%, CAD ~7.5%, BTC ~6.3%) priced via Band Protocol feeds, with weights selected on GDP, monetary-policy health and growth and adjustable through SILK Assembly peg migrations; stability maintained via overcollateralized ShadeLend minting, bounded conversion minting, redemption pools, collateral redemptions/liquidations, and ShadeDAO bonds

oracleRisk.summary: Shade documents Band Protocol data feeds for SILK basket pricing and Shade apps, with SupraOracles noted separately but no stronger failover tier verified.

branchApplicability.reviewer: OpenAI Codex Safety Score V9 oracle review
branchApplicability.rationale: Shade documents Band Protocol basket pricing and several SILK stabilization routes, but the reviewed public sources do not establish a complete current production oracle and liquidation branch for the vault, redemption-pool, and governance-controlled paths.

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-3 (lead usdd-tron-dao-reserve)
reserveReview.rationale: Re-fetched the Shade SILK documentation on 2026-07-20: the docs describe the mechanism categories (overcollateralized ShadeLend vaults at 120-150%+ collateralization, stability pool, collateral redemptions, bonds) but publish no current collateral-token weights, redemption-pool balances, or SHD exposure, and Secret Network privacy prevents independent on-chain reconciliation. The 70/20/10 split is therefore retained as a curation envelope over documented categories, not an issuer-published allocation, and the confidence is set to manual-review accordingly. The SHD slice is re-tiered from high to very-high: SHD is the protocol's own governance token, the taxonomy maps governance-token backing to very-high, and self-referential backing is the reflexive failure mode the tier exists for.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Shade Protocol documentation of SILK backing categories (fetched 2026-07-20); no published weights; 70/20/10 curation envelope retained
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current collateral-token weights, redemption-pool balances, and independent reserve reconciliation are not available in the reviewed sources (90% of the envelope unresolved); the SHD slice is a known but untracked self-referential asset.

providers.name: Shade Protocol contracts (ShadeLend vaults, stability pool, redemption pools) on Secret Network - self-custodied, no third-party custodian

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-3 (lead usdd-tron-dao-reserve)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: SILK backing sits in Shade Protocol contracts on Secret Network (ShadeLend vaults, stability pool, redemption pools) with no third-party or legal custodian, so there is no bankruptcy-remoteness structure by construction. Secret Network's privacy model prevents reading current vault balances, pool compositions, or admin key configurations from chain state, so segregation of pool types and any reuse of collateral cannot be verified; the docs describe collateral as locked until liquidation or repayment but publish no explicit rehypothecation terms. ShadeDAO assembly multisigs (thresholds and signers unverifiable remotely) govern risk parameters and the permissioned SILK minter used by bond and arbitrage modules.

mintAuthority.summary: SILK is minted as an overcollateralized CDP via ShadeLend on Secret Network; ShadeDAO assemblies (multisig branches) tune risk parameters and govern a permissioned SILK minter that bond and arbitrage (AMO) modules can also access.

controls.label: ShadeLend CDP / SILK minter contract
controls.evidence: ShadeLend issues SILK against overcollateralized user deposits (ATOM, SCRT, stables, SHD); the SILK minter is also permissioned to Shade bonds and Shade Arbitrage, so minting is mechanism-gated rather than fully permissionless.

controls.label: ShadeDAO governance assemblies (multisig branches)
controls.evidence: ShadeDAO governs via SHD tokenholders, representatives, and assembly multisigs with sanity-check votes; assemblies set collateral/peg parameters and historically held centralized control over bond/mint permissioning (Certik flagged) pending full governance rollout.

review.evidence: SILK is a basket-pegged overcollateralized CDP minted through ShadeLend, with the SILK minter additionally permissioned to bonds and arbitrage AMOs and risk parameters set by ShadeDAO assembly multisigs. Secret Network's privacy model prevents live on-chain admin reads, but the mint mechanism and governance structure are documented.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Mechanism established from Shade docs/audit coverage; Secret Network privacy precludes live verification of current minter admin keys and assembly multisig thresholds.
unresolvedQuestions: Secret Network enforces transaction-level privacy; SILK minter admin key and ShadeDAO assembly multisig thresholds/signers cannot be read from chain state. Resolution requires Secret Network node access with a viewing key or direct issuer disclosure. Bond/arbitrage minting centralization status also unconfirmable remotely.
